events.name: Children's Day Sleepover
events.details: Sleepover event on Friday, 13 November 2026 (past event). Regular school day with uniform required. After school hours, learners change into comfortable clothing for sleepover activities. Packing checklist includes: small suitcase (max 115cm), 2 sets comfortable clothes, sweatshirt/jacket, nightwear, hand towel, hygiene kit, bedsheet, blanket, pillow, floaters/footwear, optional board games/UNO cards, dry snacks. Electronic gadgets (phones, iPads, smartwatches) prohibited. Prohibited items: sharp objects, scissors, cold drinks, aerated beverages, energy drinks, chewing gum. All belongings must be labelled with child's name, grade and section.
